Name: Undertale Music Mod (More Music Mod reborn)
Author: NuwaNightstone
Description:
This mod is an updated and re-implemented version of the "More Music Mod" from 2016 that was discontinued in Stardew Valley 1.1.

Effectively, this mod replaces the ambient music present in certain areas, during rain, during nighttime, with music from the games "Undertale" and "Deltarune".

I saw many people asking for a recent version of this mod and was able to bring it to fruition with an old backup of the files from 2016 and modern mod architecture.

The mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Sound Tweaker.
Installation is simple, just download the main file and drop it into the mods folder of your stardew valley directory after installing the above dependencies.

I hope you all enjoy the mod. If you would like to support me you are able to do so through Nexus mods by downloading the mod or through a donation at https://ko-fi.com/nuwanightstone

Thank you very much.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57354076]juanpa98ar[/url] for making their Sounds of the Valley mod, which I took inspiration from.
Special thanks to Drogean for making the original mod and the banner image.
